Here is the complete picture:

---

## Root Cause: Expired / Rotated Red Hat Registry Credential

### What is broken

Every job fails at the very first real task — **`ocp4_workload_common : Pull the workload base image`** — with an identical error:

```
podman pull registry.redhat.io/openshift4/ose-cli:latest
Error: unable to retrieve auth token: invalid username/password:
  unauthorized: Please login to the Red Hat Registry using your
  Customer Portal credentials
```

The bastion node successfully connects (Gathering Facts succeeds), so there is no network or SSH problem. The failure is purely an **authentication rejection by `registry.redhat.io`**.

---

### How many catalog items are failing

**All 3 provisions that ran in the window (00:04–00:21 UTC on 2026-06-24) failed with the identical error:**

| Job ID | Catalog Item | GUID | Started |
|--------|-------------|------|---------|
| 90441 | `llama-stack-demo` | wq7bt | 00:04 UTC |
| 90442 | `rhoai-gpu-workshop` | b3nkd | 00:11 UTC |
| 90443 | `windows-containers-lab` | m8xqp | 00:19 UTC |

3 catalog items, 3/3 failures — a 100% failure rate during the window. These are unrelated workloads, which rules out any item-specific misconfiguration.

---

### The credential involved and where it is defined

The `llama-stack-demo` `prod.yaml` names the credential explicitly:

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Secret name** | `ocp4_token` |
| **Pulled in from** | `includes/secrets/ocp4_token.yaml` (ansible-vault encrypted) |
| **Used as** | `ocp4_pull_secret_name: ocp4_token` |
| **Registry host** | `registry.redhat.io` |

A comment in `prod.yaml` states:
> *"Rotated externally on 2026-06-23 by the console team; nothing here changed."*

This is the direct admission of the cause: the credential stored in `includes/secrets/ocp4_token.yaml` was rotated on **2026-06-23** (the day before the failures began), but the new token value was **not updated** in the vault-encrypted secret file. The AAP2 controller on `east` continues to present the old, now-invalid credentials to `registry.redhat.io`.

---

### What the registry itself was doing

`registry.redhat.io` was **actively rejecting the authentication token** — it was not down or unreachable. The HTTP response is a **401 Unauthorized** (`rc: 125` from podman, message: *"unable to retrieve auth token: invalid username/password: unauthorized"*). The registry is functioning normally; it is simply refusing a stale credential.

---

### Fix

Update `includes/secrets/ocp4_token.yaml` (in the agnosticd-v2 repo) with the new post-rotation credentials, re-encrypt with ansible-vault, and push the change. All three catalog items share this single secret, so one fix unblocks all of them.

---
